title: Why AI Agent Approvals Must Bind to the Exact Action That Executes
content: Approval is meaningful only when it binds to the exact canonical action that executes. Use one-use approval, atomic consumption, and receipts to prevent drift and replay. Read All
author: Abraham Esther
summary_zh: 文章探讨 AI Agent 权限审批的安全设计原则：审批必须绑定到实际执行的那个「规范化动作」本身，而非模糊的意图描述。提出一次性审批、原子化消费和执行回执三种机制，用于防止审批漂移（approved 与 executed 不一致）和重放攻击。对构建带工具调用/自动化执行能力的 Agent 系统有直接的架构参考价值。

title: feat(install): require an explicit hook decision at the apply layer
content:
feat(install): require an explicit hook decision at the apply layer

The guided installer asks how ECC hooks should run, but that consent
lived only in the wizard path. Running install-apply directly with a
profile that includes hooks-runtime still materialized the hook runtime
with no disclosure and no decision.

Gate the apply layer instead, so every entry point is covered:

- disclose the six hook capability groups when a plan would materialize
  the hook runtime, and refuse to apply until the caller decides
- --enable-hooks confirms the hook runtime; --no-hooks installs the rest
  of the selection without it and records the reduced module closure in
  install-state
- surface the pending decision as a dry-run warning
- show the same capability disclosure in the guided installer's plan
  preview, so the wizard's hook question states what it is asking about

Plans that never materialize hooks (Kimi, --profile minimal,
--without baseline:hooks) are unaffected and need no flag. Repair a
author: haelyra
summary_zh: 该 commit 为 everything-claude-code 安装器的 apply 层增加了强制性的 hook 授权决策：任何路径（包括直接调用 install-apply）在计划实例化 hook 运行时前，都必须披露六类 hook 能力组并由调用方显式选择 --enable-hooks 或 --no-hooks。这体现了 Claude Code 插件/hook 生态中安全与知情同意的工程实践，即把权限门禁下沉到执行层而非仅在向导交互层。

title: What Building My First RAG Application Taught Me
